changes: Runtime package only: on a Modwerk base that owns the playback-increment site 0x40004100 (sdk/machines/octatrack/events.json), REPITCH's tempo scaling is an ev_play_increment subscriber (order 50) instead of a raw detour, so it installs beside POLY8 and any other subscriber. The scaling code is the same macro rate_hook uses; native octabam builds assemble byte-identical.

Limits: needs a base built with site events; older bases refuse this package, and Undo keeps 0.1.2-experimental for them. Emulator evidence only (synthetic register state at the site); no hardware run, and the native gate verify_repitch.py was not rerun because the native bytes are unchanged.
Documentation-only: add real emulator screenshots of the selection and control pages, access instructions and capture provenance. The firmware implementation is unchanged.
Documentation-only: update author credits in the manifest and guides. The firmware implementation is unchanged.
First Modwerk catalog release of REPITCH for Flex/Static tracks: follow project tempo through playback speed instead of granular timestretch.
Add RPCH to track TSTR and REPITCH to sample attributes. PTCH is disabled while RATE still applies; Pickup machines are unsupported.
